definition_semantics.name: singleBlockPrecision kappa O

definition_semantics.verdict: Twice restriction to det=+1/-1 agrees with conditional probability for n>=3.
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: Sign sets measurable with Haar mass 1/2; normalized actual probability priors, not supplied probability witnesses.

definition_semantics.name: gamma
definition_semantics.verdict: Mean zero and inverse precision covariance match.
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: Actual multivariateGaussian/Euclidean API must have the sealed covariance meaning; covariance validity proved internally. API bodies not inspected.

definition_semantics.name: p O x
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: Actual-law density equality, nonnegativity, measurability and unit integral. B.2.3 names the genuine density without deriving this full concrete correspondence.

definition_semantics.name: qpos,qneg
definition_semantics.verdict: Pointwise real Bochner average is a valid chosen representative once its actual mixture-density equality is proved.
definition_semantics.choice: Explicit average of literal p under actual sign-conditioned prior.
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: For every x, absolute O-integrability; joint/kernel measurability; q_b>=0; actual bind density equality; integral q_b=1. A totalized nonintegrable integral returning zero is not an acceptable fallback.

definition_semantics.name: Ppos,Pneg
definition_semantics.verdict: Actual conditioned Gaussian bind laws match the mixture.
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: Genuine bind probability, same exact priors/gamma, no free or surrogate laws.

definition_semantics.name: delta
definition_semantics.verdict: Event supremum over all measurable B is normalized TV, with the correct absolute difference and no factor 2.
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: Finite probability laws, nonempty bounded event-value set, and equality to (1/2) integral |qpos-qneg|.

definition_semantics.name: a
definition_semantics.verdict: Real volume integral of sqrt(qpos*qneg) matches source affinity.
definition_semantics.required_internal_evidence: Genuine outer Integrable is a conclusion; sqrt agrees with nonnegative density semantics; affinity and all source formulas remain invariant under a.e. replacement.
